result.blueprint_hero_archetype: Full-bleed overlay hero

result.notes: The blueprint hero (an-hero) uses a full-bleed background image (21/10 aspect, 520px min-height) with a dark-to-transparent-to-dark gradient overlay, and text absolutely positioned and vertically centered over the image. The current hero-split tile fundamentally changes this to a side-by-side split layout (1.2fr 0.8fr ratio) with a showcase stats panel on the right—a different archetype entirely.
